THE TAVERN HEIST

The Guard walks the King's Head with the cheese under his arm, Cellar to Hearth and back. The Bard's lute can make him forget his round, and the Cat is already by the fireplace.

Loading the engine...

Play

You are the Cat. Pick a verb, then click a person, a prop, or a mark (the round markers on the ground). The Cat walks over before it acts; Look works from where it stands. Point before you click: what a click would act on lights up with its action, and the line above the verbs says it too.

The rules

Nothing here is a cutscene. The Guard's patrol, his charm, and the theft are three rules that react to facts: while he is charmed he stops patrolling and turns to the Bard, and once the Cat carries the cheese he turns to the Cat. Change a fact and the same rules play out differently.

Walkthrough

  1. Press Next step once: the Bard's lute charms the Guard.
  2. Press Next step again: the Cat takes the cheese while he is distracted.
  3. Watch the Guard turn to the Cat, a fact he only just started to carry.

Keys

  • 1 to 9: pick a line
  • Enter, Space, or a click: next message
  • S: play the next step for you
  • Right-click: next verb
  • I: state inspector (the facts as a graph; the game pauses)
Runs entirely in your browser on the BeSpoke Engine, a simulation engine for systemic and narrative games. The whole game is in this one file; nothing is downloaded or tracked.
